Data lineage & authority — what this surface is, and what it is not
Authority is per FIELD, not per system.
  • Item # identity, variant structure (L/A/F roles), BOM → Acctivate
  • Per-channel price, case pack, MAP/MSRP → the five Sales price lists — authoritative but not self-validating. Acctivate manages no pricing at all, so for price this master IS the record.
  • Fill / net weight → Acctivate BOM, derived
  • DTC storefront state → Shopify (one channel only)
  • Production / labor cost → CostSmith
Shopify Metafields are a publication target, not a system of record. The Field Registry tab answers “which field, whose, how covered” locally — ask it instead of scanning Shopify.
  1. Acctivate + price lists + spec sheets → Automations/rebuild.py
  2. build_catalog_browser.py → catalog-browser-data.json (ingest stage, no longer a page)
  3. build_dtc_content_layer.py → dtc_products + dtc_product_items bridge
  4. teeccino-product-master.sqlite → this page
The former Product Catalog Browser (catalog.html) is the Catalog Content tab. One ERP surface. Its card-grid + drawer presentation was restored 2026-07-28.

One card per finished good (base Item #) — what a product is, independent of where it is sold. Suffixes (L/A/F) are channel/pack roles, not distinct products: 80010L and 80010 are the SAME finished good. Click a card for identity, all four channels, and its data-quality flags. Photos come from a linked DTC listing where one exists.

A different grain, on purpose. This tab is one card per Shopify DTC listing; the Items tab is one card per finished good (base Item #) across all four channels. One listing can sell several finished goods (10 oz / 5 lb / trial are separate goods sharing one page), so copy fans out through the dtc_product_items bridge instead of being flattened onto one item. Every heading in the drawer carries its source and owner as a tooltip — hover the ⓘ.

Every Shopify Metafield in use, who owns it, and how many in-scope DTC items carry a value. Ask this instead of scanning Shopify. Metafields are a publication target, not the record — and >89% of the Metafields on these products are app-owned or legacy junk, so answering a field question without the ownership filter is how you end up editing an app's data.

Flags are the product, not a byproduct. data_quality is a first-class table with provenance. Cross-list disagreement on an identical item is the real error signal; a BOM-vs-list gap is not. Click any row with an Item # to open that finished good.

Canonical source: data/teeccino-product-master.sqlite. Rebuild with python Automations/rebuild.py (never build_product_master_db.py directly — it deletes the sqlite and drops the attribute layer).
Then prove it renders: python Automations/verify_erp_surface.py. Refresh shopify-enrichment.json BEFORE rebuilding, or this page will report cached pre-write values as current.
